item.title: Supreme Court Digest: Jan. 28, 2026
item.description: These opinions were released by the Minnesota Supreme Court.

item.title: Supreme Court reinstates attorney Clayton Halunen
item.description: A divided Minnesota Supreme Court reinstated Clayton Halunen after an indefinite suspension for professional misconduct.

item.title: Walz appoints John Fitzgerald to 8th District bench
item.description: Gov. Tim Walz has appointed Meeker County prosecutor John Fitzgerald as a District Court judge in Minnesota’s 8th Judicial District.

item.title: Pass-through entity tax has expired. What now?
item.description: Minnesota’s pass-through entity tax expired at the end of 2025, leaving businesses uncertain whether lawmakers will reinstate the SALT workaround.

item.title: Judge tosses federal murder charges in UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
item.description: A New York federal judge dismissed murder and weapons charges against Luigi Mangione, removing the possibility of a federal death penalty.

item.title: Perspectives: Roberts’ Rules: The chief’s Minnesota cases
item.description: As Chief Justice John Roberts turns 71, a look back at five major Minnesota cases he authored or shaped during two decades on the U.S. Supreme Court.

item.title: Judge declines to halt Trump Minnesota crackdown
item.description: U.S. District Judge Kate Menendez declined to order a halt to Trump’s immigration enforcement crackdown in Minneapolis

item.title: 5-year-old Liam is home, but data shows ICE detaining more kids
item.description: Federal data show a sharp rise in children detained under Trump’s immigration crackdown, drawing legal challenges, court rebukes and civil rights concerns.

item.title: DOJ misconduct complaint against D.C. federal judge dismissed
item.description: A federal appeals court dismissed a judicial misconduct complaint against D.C. Judge James Boasberg, finding no evidence of bias against Trump.
